content:
Use a STYLE block to lock the overall look (e.g., photoreal cinematic, 8K, ultra-detailed, organic film grain, strong motion blur, filmic dawn grade) so every cut inherits the same visual treatment.

Define numbered reference images (<<<image_1>>>…<<<image_5>>>) and restate them under ACTIVE REFERENCES with “100% matches” to hard-lock locations/characters/wardrobe across the whole sequence.

Add explicit negative constraints inside character refs to prevent unwanted props/actions (e.g., elf fights ONLY with an elven SWORD — no bow, no arrows, no archery).

Specify FORMAT MODE: SEQUENCE OF CUTS and explicitly list CUT 1…CUT 4 with “cuts only at the specified points; the camera does not cut on its own” to stop the model from inserting extra edits.

For complex multi-shot prompts, write separate OPTICS and CAMERA sections per cut with exact FOV targets (e.g., 18° tight portrait, 84° wide → 47° → 18° macro, 107° ultra-wide) to control lensing and perceived scale.

When you need a continuous move, explicitly state the cut is one continuous take (e.g., CUT 2 is one continuous FPV-drone take) and describe the path step-by-step (wide side view → weave through fighters → whip down into grass → thread around subjects).

Use a SCALE LOCK section with concrete relative size language (e.g., palm-sized knights at ground level; elves/orcs read as four humans stacked head-to-toe vs grass) to enforce miniature/giant relationships.

Add POSITIVE LOCKS as a checklist of non-negotiables (cut order, weapon restrictions, exactly two tiny knights, uniqueness of elves/orcs, consistent sun direction/wardrobe, no ghosting/flicker) to reduce drift and continuity errors.

Control lighting continuity by specifying sun direction and technical values (e.g., dawn backlight screen-right, mist density ~40%, white balance 5000K) and then detailing per-cut lighting beats.

If you want SFX-only outputs, explicitly state “Diegetic SFX only, no music” and provide per-cut audio cues to guide sound design.

Usa un bloque STYLE para fijar el aspecto general (por ejemplo, photoreal cinematic, 8K, ultra-detailed, organic film grain, strong motion blur, filmic dawn grade) para que cada corte herede el mismo tratamiento visual.

Define imágenes de referencia numeradas (<<<image_1>>>…<<<image_5>>>) y vuélvelas a mencionar en ACTIVE REFERENCES con “100% matches” para fijar al máximo ubicaciones/personajes/vestuario en toda la secuencia.

Añade restricciones negativas explícitas dentro de las referencias de personaje para evitar props/acciones no deseados (por ejemplo, elfo lucha SOLO con una ESPADA élfica — no bow, no arrows, no archery).

Especifica FORMAT MODE: SEQUENCE OF CUTS y enumera explícitamente CUT 1…CUT 4 con “cuts only at the specified points; the camera does not cut on its own” para impedir que el modelo inserte ediciones extra.

Para prompts complejos de varias tomas, escribe secciones separadas de OPTICS y CAMERA por cada corte con objetivos exactos de FOV (por ejemplo, 18° tight portrait, 84° wide → 47° → 18° macro, 107° ultra-wide) para controlar el lensing y la escala percibida.

Cuando necesites un movimiento continuo, indica explícitamente que el corte es un one continuous take (por ejemplo, CUT 2 is one continuous FPV-drone take) y describe la trayectoria paso a paso (wide side view → weave through fighters → whip down into grass → thread around subjects).

Usa una sección SCALE LOCK con lenguaje concreto de tamaño relativo (por ejemplo, palm-sized knights at ground level; elves/orcs read as four humans stacked head-to-toe vs grass) para imponer relaciones miniatura/gigante.

Añade POSITIVE LOCKS como una checklist de elementos no negociables (cut order, weapon restrictions, exactly two tiny knights, uniqueness of elves/orcs, consistent sun direction/wardrobe, no ghosting/flicker) para reducir desviaciones y errores de continuidad.

Controla la continuidad de la iluminación especificando la dirección del sol y valores técnicos (por ejemplo, dawn backlight screen-right, mist density ~40%, white balance 5000K) y luego detallando los beats de iluminación por corte.

Si quieres salidas solo de SFX, indica explícitamente “Diegetic SFX only, no music” y proporciona cues de audio por corte para guiar el diseño sonoro.

fr.content:
Utilisez un bloc STYLE pour verrouiller l’apparence globale (par ex. photoreal cinematic, 8K, ultra-detailed, organic film grain, strong motion blur, filmic dawn grade) afin que chaque cut hérite du même traitement visuel.

Définissez des images de référence numérotées (<<<image_1>>>…<<<image_5>>>) et réaffirmez-les sous ACTIVE REFERENCES avec “100% matches” pour verrouiller strictement les lieux/personnages/tenues sur toute la séquence.

Ajoutez des contraintes négatives explicites dans les références de personnages pour empêcher les accessoires/actions indésirables (par ex. l’elfe se bat UNIQUEMENT avec une ÉPÉE elfique — pas d’arc, pas de flèches, pas de tir à l’arc).

Spécifiez FORMAT MODE: SEQUENCE OF CUTS et listez explicitement CUT 1…CUT 4 avec “cuts only at the specified points; the camera does not cut on its own” pour empêcher le modèle d’ajouter des edits supplémentaires.

Pour les prompts multi-plans complexes, rédigez des sections OPTICS et CAMERA séparées pour chaque cut avec des cibles exactes de FOV (par ex. 18° tight portrait, 84° wide → 47° → 18° macro, 107° ultra-wide) afin de contrôler la focale et l’échelle perçue.

Lorsque vous avez besoin d’un mouvement continu, indiquez explicitement que le cut est un plan-séquence continu (par ex. CUT 2 is one continuous FPV-drone take) et décrivez le trajet étape par étape (wide side view → weave through fighters → whip down into grass → thread around subjects).

Utilisez une section SCALE LOCK avec un langage concret sur les tailles relatives (par ex. palm-sized knights at ground level; elves/orcs read as four humans stacked head-to-toe vs grass) pour imposer les rapports miniature/géant.

Ajoutez des POSITIVE LOCKS sous forme de checklist des éléments non négociables (ordre des cuts, restrictions d’armes, exactement deux petits chevaliers, unicité des elfes/orcs, direction du soleil/tenues cohérentes, pas de ghosting/flicker) afin de réduire la dérive et les erreurs de continuité.

Contrôlez la continuité de l’éclairage en précisant la direction du soleil et les valeurs techniques (par ex. dawn backlight screen-right, mist density ~40%, white balance 5000K), puis en détaillant les temps forts d’éclairage pour chaque cut.

Si vous voulez des sorties uniquement en SFX, indiquez explicitement “Diegetic SFX only, no music” et fournissez des indications audio par cut pour guider le sound design.

ja.content:
STYLEブロックを使って全体の見た目を固定します（例：photoreal cinematic、8K、ultra-detailed、organic film grain、strong motion blur、filmic dawn grade）。これにより、すべてのカットが同じビジュアル処理を継承します。

番号付きの参照画像（<<<image_1>>>…<<<image_5>>>）を定義し、ACTIVE REFERENCES の下で「100% matches」として再記載して、シーケンス全体を通してロケーション／キャラクター／衣装を厳密に固定します。

キャラクター参照の中に明示的な negative constraints を追加して、不要な小道具やアクションを防ぎます（例：elf は elven SWORD だけで戦う — bow、arrows、archery は一切なし）。

FORMAT MODE を SEQUENCE OF CUTS と明記し、CUT 1…CUT 4 をはっきり列挙して、「cuts only at the specified points; the camera does not cut on its own」と書き、モデルが余計な編集を挿入しないようにします。

複雑なマルチショットの prompt では、各カットごとに OPTICS と CAMERA のセクションを分け、正確な FOV ターゲット（例：18° tight portrait、84° wide → 47° → 18° macro、107° ultra-wide）を指定して、レンズ感と見かけのスケールを制御します。

連続した動きが必要な場合は、カットが one continuous take であることを明示し（例：CUT 2 is one continuous FPV-drone take）、その経路を step-by-step で記述します（wide side view → weave through fighters → whip down into grass → thread around subjects）。

SCALE LOCK セクションを使い、具体的な相対サイズの表現を入れます（例：palm-sized knights at ground level; elves/orcs read as four humans stacked head-to-toe vs grass）。これにより、ミニチュア／巨人の関係を厳密に維持できます。

POSITIVE LOCKS を、譲れない条件のチェックリストとして追加します（cut order、weapon restrictions、exactly two tiny knights、uniqueness of elves/orcs、consistent sun direction/wardrobe、no ghosting/flicker）。これでブレや連続性エラーを減らせます。

ライティングの連続性は、太陽の向きと技術値を指定して制御します（例：dawn backlight screen-right、mist density ~40%、white balance 5000K）。そのうえで、カットごとの lighting beats を詳しく記述します。

SFX のみの出力にしたい場合は、明示的に「Diegetic SFX only, no music」と書き、各カットの audio cues を提示して、サウンドデザインの指針を与えます。

ko.content:
전체적인 룩을 고정하려면 STYLE 블록을 사용하세요(예: photoreal cinematic, 8K, ultra-detailed, organic film grain, strong motion blur, filmic dawn grade). 이렇게 하면 모든 컷이 동일한 비주얼 처리를 그대로 이어받습니다.

번호가 매겨진 reference images(<<<image_1>>>…<<<image_5>>>)를 정의하고, 이를 ACTIVE REFERENCES 아래에 “100% matches”로 다시 명시해 시퀀스 전체에서 location/character/wardrobe를 강하게 고정하세요.

원치 않는 소품/행동을 막기 위해 character refs 안에 명시적인 negative constraints를 추가하세요(예: elf fights ONLY with an elven SWORD — no bow, no arrows, no archery).

FORMAT MODE: SEQUENCE OF CUTS를 지정하고, CUT 1…CUT 4를 명시적으로 나열한 뒤 “cuts only at the specified points; the camera does not cut on its own”이라고 적어 모델이 추가 편집을 삽입하지 못하게 하세요.

복잡한 멀티샷 prompt의 경우, 각 컷마다 별도의 OPTICS와 CAMERA 섹션을 작성하고 정확한 FOV 타깃(예: 18° tight portrait, 84° wide → 47° → 18° macro, 107° ultra-wide)을 넣어 lensing과 perceived scale을 제어하세요.

연속적인 움직임이 필요할 때는 컷이 하나의 continuous take임을 명시적으로 적고(예: CUT 2 is one continuous FPV-drone take), 경로를 단계별로 설명하세요(wide side view → weave through fighters → whip down into grass → thread around subjects).

SCALE LOCK 섹션을 사용해 구체적인 상대적 크기 표현을 넣으세요(예: palm-sized knights at ground level; elves/orcs read as four humans stacked head-to-toe vs grass)로 miniature/giant 관계를 강제하세요.

POSITIVE LOCKS를 절대 바뀌면 안 되는 항목들의 체크리스트로 추가하세요(cut order, weapon restrictions, exactly two tiny knights, uniqueness of elves/orcs, consistent sun direction/wardrobe, no ghosting/flicker) — 이렇게 하면 drift와 continuity errors를 줄일 수 있습니다.

조명 연속성은 sun direction과 기술적 수치(예: dawn backlight screen-right, mist density ~40%, white balance 5000K)를 지정한 뒤, 컷별 lighting beats를 자세히 적어 제어하세요.

SFX-only 출력을 원한다면 “Diegetic SFX only, no music”라고 명시하고, 사운드 디자인을 안내할 수 있도록 컷별 audio cues를 제공하세요.

pt.content:
Use um bloco STYLE para travar a aparência geral (por exemplo, photoreal cinematic, 8K, ultra-detailed, organic film grain, strong motion blur, filmic dawn grade) para que cada corte herde o mesmo tratamento visual.

Defina imagens de referência numeradas (<<<image_1>>>…<<<image_5>>>) e reafirme-as em ACTIVE REFERENCES com “100% matches” para travar rigidamente locações/personagens/figurinos em toda a sequência.

Adicione restrições negativas explícitas dentro das referências de personagem para impedir props/ações indesejados (por exemplo, o elfo luta SOMENTE com uma ESPADA élfica — sem arco, sem flechas, sem arquearia).

Especifique FORMAT MODE: SEQUENCE OF CUTS e liste explicitamente CUT 1…CUT 4 com “cuts only at the specified points; the camera does not cut on its own” para impedir que o modelo insira edições extras.

Para prompts complexos com múltiplos planos, escreva seções separadas de OPTICS e CAMERA para cada corte com alvos exatos de FOV (por exemplo, 18° tight portrait, 84° wide → 47° → 18° macro, 107° ultra-wide) para controlar a lente e a escala percebida.

Quando precisar de um movimento contínuo, declare explicitamente que o corte é um único take contínuo (por exemplo, CUT 2 is one continuous FPV-drone take) e descreva o percurso passo a passo (wide side view → weave through fighters → whip down into grass → thread around subjects).

Use uma seção SCALE LOCK com linguagem concreta de proporção relativa (por exemplo, palm-sized knights at ground level; elves/orcs read as four humans stacked head-to-toe vs grass) para impor relações de miniatura/gigante.

Adicione POSITIVE LOCKS como uma checklist de itens inegociáveis (ordem dos cortes, restrições de armas, exatamente dois cavaleiros minúsculos, unicidade de elfos/orcs, direção do sol/figurino consistentes, sem ghosting/flicker) para reduzir desvios e erros de continuidade.

Controle a continuidade da iluminação especificando a direção do sol e valores técnicos (por exemplo, dawn backlight screen-right, mist density ~40%, white balance 5000K) e depois detalhando os beats de iluminação de cada corte.

Se quiser saídas apenas com SFX, declare explicitamente “Diegetic SFX only, no music” e forneça cues de áudio por corte para orientar o sound design.

zh.content:
使用一个 STYLE block 来锁定整体视觉风格（例如 photoreal cinematic、8K、ultra-detailed、organic film grain、strong motion blur、filmic dawn grade），这样每个 cut 都会继承相同的视觉处理。

定义编号参考图（<<<image_1>>>…<<<image_5>>>），并在 ACTIVE REFERENCES 下用“100% matches”重新列出它们，以便在整个序列中强力锁定地点/角色/服装。

在角色参考中加入明确的 negative constraints，防止出现不想要的道具/动作（例如，elf 只用一把 elven SWORD 战斗——不要 bow、不要 arrows、不要 archery）。

指定 FORMAT MODE: SEQUENCE OF CUTS，并明确列出 CUT 1…CUT 4，同时写明“cuts only at the specified points; the camera does not cut on its own”，以阻止模型插入额外剪辑。

对于复杂的多镜头 prompt，为每个 cut 分别写 OPTICS 和 CAMERA 部分，并给出精确的 FOV 目标（例如，18° tight portrait、84° wide → 47° → 18° macro、107° ultra-wide），以控制镜头焦段和感知尺度。

当你需要连续运动时，明确说明该 cut 是 one continuous take（例如，CUT 2 is one continuous FPV-drone take），并逐步描述路径（wide side view → weave through fighters → whip down into grass → thread around subjects）。

使用 SCALE LOCK 部分，并用具体的相对尺寸语言（例如，palm-sized knights at ground level；elves/orcs read as four humans stacked head-to-toe vs grass）来强化微缩/巨物关系。

添加 POSITIVE LOCKS 作为不可妥协项的检查清单（cut 顺序、武器限制、恰好两个 tiny knights、elves/orcs 的唯一性、太阳方向/服装一致、no ghosting/flicker），以减少漂移和连续性错误。

通过指定太阳方向和技术参数来控制光照连续性（例如，dawn backlight screen-right、mist density ~40%、white balance 5000K），然后再细化每个 cut 的 lighting beats。

如果你想要仅 SFX 输出，请明确写明“Diegetic SFX only, no music”，并为每个 cut 提供音频提示，以引导声音设计。
